input.hypothesis: Photonic interconnects get adopted in datacenters faster than expected

nodes.statement: By 2026-05-20, at least one hyperscaler (Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon) publicly discloses co-packaged optics (CPO) deployment in production datacenter clusters at scale (≥1,000 switches/links).
nodes.resolution: Resolves YES if a hyperscaler press release, earnings call, or OCP contribution confirms CPO in production at stated scale by date; NO if only pilots, demos, or roadmaps.
nodes.rationale: Reference class: prior optical interconnect transitions (100G→400G) took ~3 years from demo to hyperscale production. CPO demos (Broadcom Tomahawk 5, NVIDIA Quantum-X) are 2024-25; production at 1,000+ links within 12 months is plausible but not majority-likely given thermal/reliability qualification cycles.
assumptions: CPO defined as co-packaged, not just pluggable optics
nodes.marketQuery: Will a hyperscaler announce production co-packaged optics deployment by May 2026?

nodes.name: Hyperscaler AI capex (Big-4 annualized)
nodes.rationale: Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta guided combined 2025 capex near $300B, heavily AI-infrastructure weighted. Continued growth is the demand pull for bandwidth-dense optics; a capex pause would delay adoption.

nodes.name: 800G pluggable optics module price
nodes.rationale: Coherent/pluggable module prices historically fall 15-25%/yr (Infinera/Coherent analogs). Falling pluggable prices are the key inhibitor: cheap pluggables reduce CPO's power/cost advantage.

nodes.statement: CPO switch suppliers (Broadcom, NVIDIA) ship ≥10,000 cumulative CPO switch units by 2026-05-20.
nodes.resolution: YES if supplier disclosures or credible supply-chain reports confirm cumulative shipments; NO if shipments remain in hundreds/thousands.
nodes.rationale: Analog: NVIDIA Quantum-X InfiniBand CPO targeted 2025 shipments; Broadcom Bailly ecosystem shipping since 2024. Yield on fiber-attach assembly is the bottleneck; 10k units implies yield maturity.
analogs: Silicon photonics yield ramps at TSMC/GlobalFoundries
nodes.marketQuery: Will CPO switch shipments exceed 10,000 cumulative units by May 2026?

nodes.statement: A major AI cluster buildout is publicly constrained by switch/network power or cooling before 2026-05-20, cited by a hyperscaler.
nodes.resolution: YES if hyperscaler or grid operator cites networking power as a binding constraint in filings/statements; NO otherwise.
nodes.rationale: Optics already ~10% of cluster power at 800G scale; analogs: Microsoft's 2024 statements on power as top constraint. Power pressure is the strongest promoter of CPO (30-70% interconnect power savings).
assumptions: Networking power share grows with AI scale-out
nodes.marketQuery: Will networking power constraints be cited as a datacenter bottleneck by 2026?

nodes.statement: OCP or IEEE finalizes an interoperable CPO/linear-pluggable spec enabling multi-vendor optics by 2026-05-20.
nodes.resolution: YES if ratified/published spec; NO if still draft.
nodes.rationale: OCP has active CPO projects (LPO, CPO); historical analog: 400ZR took ~2 years draft-to-ratification. Standards reduce lock-in fear, a secondary promoter.
nodes.marketQuery: Will OCP ratify a CPO interoperability spec by May 2026?

nodes.statement: A publicized field reliability failure in deployed CPO/LPO optics causes a hyperscaler to delay rollout plans by 2026-05-20.
nodes.resolution: YES if credible reporting of incident plus stated delay; NO otherwise.
nodes.rationale: Counter-force: early fiber-attach and laser reliability issues (analog: early QSFP-DD failure rates, 2019). Non-repairable CPO packages raise stakes; a visible failure would push adoption right.
analogs: Google TPU optical circuit switch learning curve
nodes.marketQuery: Will a CPO reliability incident delay hyperscaler adoption by 2026?

nodes.statement: NVIDIA ships optical (silicon-photonics) transceivers at scale in NVLink/Quantum-X ecosystems by 2026-05-20.
nodes.resolution: YES if confirmed volume shipments (>1,000 systems) in customer deployments; NO if limited to announced SKUs.
nodes.rationale: NVIDIA announced photonic Quantum-X for 2025-26; analog: InfiniBand adoption curve post-2010. NVIDIA's vertical integration makes it the fastest single promoter path into datacenters.
nodes.marketQuery: Will NVIDIA ship silicon photonics transceivers at scale by May 2026?

nodes.statement: Linear pluggable optics (LPO) — a CPO substitute — captures majority of new 800G hyperscaler deployments by 2026-05-20.
nodes.resolution: YES if LPO share of new 800G ports >50% per credible supply-chain data; NO otherwise.
nodes.rationale: Counter-force: LPO offers much of CPO's power savings with pluggable serviceability, delaying CPO specifically. Analog: LRO delayed coherent adoption in 2015-17.
nodes.marketQuery: Will LPO capture majority of new 800G deployments by May 2026?

nodes.statement: By 2026-05-20, co-packaged optics are adopted in datacenters faster than consensus expectations (production deployment at ≥1 hyperscaler plus ≥10,000 cumulative CPO switch shipments).
nodes.resolution: YES if both root and supply_yield resolve YES; NO otherwise.
nodes.rationale: Joint probability of hyperscaler production disclosure (~30%) and shipment scale (~35%), correlated upward by power pressure and NVIDIA pull, discounted by LPO substitution and pluggable cost declines.
assumptions: Correlation between disclosure and shipments is positive
nodes.marketQuery: Will CPO datacenter adoption beat consensus expectations by May 2026?

edges.mechanism: Larger AI clusters raise networking power draw, making optics power a visible constraint
assumptions: Capex converts to deployed clusters within 2-3 quarters
Networking share of power rises with scale-out

edges.mechanism: Power pressure pushes hyperscalers to adopt CPO's 30-70% interconnect power savings in production
assumptions: CPO power savings verified in field
No equivalent savings from LPO at same timeline

edges.mechanism: NVIDIA's integrated photonic InfiniBand/NVLink ecosystem forces hyperscalers to qualify and deploy CPO
assumptions: Customers buy rack-scale systems including optics

edges.mechanism: Mature fiber-attach yields enable volume supply needed for production-scale deployment
Interoperable specs reduce vendor lock-in risk, easing hyperscaler procurement approval
assumptions: Spec covers CPO not just LPO

edges.mechanism: Falling pluggable prices erode CPO's total-cost advantage, delaying production commitment
assumptions: Pluggable power gap remains acceptable to hyperscalers

edges.mechanism: LPO captures power savings with serviceable pluggables, deferring CPO-specific adoption
Publicized field failure of non-repairable CPO packages triggers qualification delays
assumptions: Hyperscaler publicly links delay to optics

edges.mechanism: Field failures force requalification, slowing cumulative shipment ramp
Hyperscaler production disclosure is the primary evidence of faster-than-expected adoption
Shipment scale confirms adoption is broader than a single announcement
assumptions: Shipments reach end customers, not inventory

edges.mechanism: AI capex demand pulls NVIDIA rack-scale systems that bundle photonic interconnects
assumptions: Quantum-X attach rate follows system sales

summary.headline: CPO adoption beats consensus within 12 months only if power pressure and NVIDIA's photonic ecosystem overcome cheap pluggables and LPO substitution; base ~18%.
summary.mainUncertainty: Whether hyperscalers commit to non-repairable CPO in production, or settle for LPO/pluggables that capture most power savings with less risk.
followUps: Track NVIDIA Quantum-X shipment disclosures quarterly
Monitor OCP CPO/LPO spec ratification status
Watch hyperscaler earnings calls for networking power constraint language
Track 800G pluggable module pricing trends (Coherent, Lumentum)
